Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly synthesized the dates by introducing an arbitrary “earlier-bound tie-breaker” rule and selected 405 CE, despite sources indicating the Rhine crossing occurred at the end of 406 (often specified as December 31, 406) or within 406–407. This misinterpretation of end-of-year timing and disregard of the cited evidence led directly to the wrong answer.
